spices.name: Turmeric
spices.whole: Whole cured and dried turmeric bulbs or fingers
spices.scope: Five metal entries explicitly name whole and powdered turmeric. The named lead row gives 10 mg/kg without a dry-matter qualifier. The named arsenic row gives 0.1 mg/kg. Both aflatoxin entries name the spice category.

ingredients.name: Haridra
ingredients.stage: The method adds turmeric with the salt, roasted rice and pulses. It leaves the form of the supplied rhizome open.

recipes.sourceReviewResult: The Krishara brief records ginger and turmeric independently. Five metal entries explicitly name whole and powdered turmeric. Confirmed dried ginger uses separate spice entries with their own reporting bases.
recipes.sourceReviewNextAction: Identify each rhizome and its supplied form before processing. Check the lead-chromate requirement for whole or powdered turmeric separately from total lead.

ingredients.name: Ardraka

recipes.sourceReviewResult: Confirmed dried ginger has four candidate raw-spice entries. The first preparation uses pieces of ginger, and that description alone leaves the supplier form open.
recipes.sourceReviewNextAction: Document the ginger received separately from the selected flower. Assess each finished milk preparation on its own evidence.
